name: Hotel Vila Vita Parc
positioning: Clifftop Algarve resort laid out like a traditional Portuguese village, with rooms, suites and villas set in park landscape
best_for: Groups of friends or families wanting a resort villa with an infinity pool
Spa and wellness travelers, with a Sisley treatment menu and a garden yoga pavilion

facts.text: The resort's address is Rua Anneliese Pohl, Alporchinhos, Porches.
The resort villas are aimed at groups of friends or families holidaying together.
The Vista Parc Apartments are next to the resort, and their guests can use all the resort's services and facilities.
The Vila Vita Collection is a set of luxury serviced villas and beachfront residences in the Algarve, outside the resort, owned and managed by Vila Vita Parc.
The Vila Vita Biergarten serves German and artisanal beers, including Porches Craft Beer.
The resort has boutiques in the Piazetta.
The spa offers medical-grade pedicures from podiatrist Margaret Dabbs.
Personal trainers are on hand for custom workouts and the HYPOXI Method.
The resort's wellness approach places equal emphasis on body, soul and mind, with nutrition, mindfulness and exercise plans.
Vila Vita Parc appears in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards for 2026.

highlights.text: The resort is reminiscent of a traditional Portuguese village, with cobblestone pathways, flower-filled gardens and waterways.
Rooms and suites sit above the cliff top in several distinct buildings, each with its own character and architecture, surrounded by a park landscape.
The resort villas have outdoor areas with infinity pools, spacious gardens and ocean-view terraces.
The spa occupies its own dedicated building, and its treatment menu was created in partnership with Sisley.
The spa has a garden yoga pavilion for private, group and aerial classes.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the location is remote, so getting to nearby towns requires transportation.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
The Vila Vita Collection villas and residences are outside the resort, so they are not a stay within the resort grounds.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Vila Vita Parc review
